newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American to buy Carnival Hotels -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American to buy Carnival Hotels -WSJ.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc is in talks to acquire Carnival Hotels & Casinos for about $700 million in cash, stock and operating partnership units, the Wall Street Journal said in Thursday's electronic edition.
But one person familiar with the situation was quoted by the paper as saying "It's not a done deal yet," adding that there were other options on the table.

According to people familiar with the deal, many hotels in Miami-based Carnival's portfolio could be converted into Wyndham hotels, which Patriot was also understood to be in talks to buy, the paper said.
Neither company could be reached for comment in the report.
